reason: This is a large cross-cutting change to the expression context model, not a local refactor. Separating `BuildContext` from `EvalContext` touches core expression semantics, constant folding/propagation, planner expression rewriting and optimization, executor runtime paths (joins, aggregates, window, insert/update, DistSQL), plus table/store/mock coprocessor code. A context split like this can hide high-severity regressions in type inference, collation/session-dependent evaluation, plan/build vs runtime behavior, and pushdown/PB encoding semantics.
